sb.name: Abominable Totem
sb.condition_immunities: exhaustion, poisoned
sb.languages: understands Common, Druidic, Elvish, and Sylvan but can't speak

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the abominable totem remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a dead tree.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The abominable totem deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Totemic Fortitude
traits.desc: If damage reduces the abominable totem to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is fire or from a critical hit. On a success, the abominable totem drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The abominable totem makes two attacks. Withering

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. If this effect reduces a creature's hit point maximum to 0, the creature dies. This reduction to a creature's hit point maximum lasts until the creature finishes a long rest or until it is affected by a spell like greater restoration.

actions.name: Grave Root
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 180 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d10) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of the abominable totem's next turn.

actions.name: Raise Trees (1/Day)
actions.desc: The abominable totem magically animates one or two dead trees it can see within 60 feet of it. These trees have the same statistics as an abominable totem, except they have Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1, and they have only the Withering Slam action option. An animated tree acts as an ally of the abominable totem. The tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies; until the abominable totem dies or is more than 120 feet from the tree; or until the abominable totem takes a bonus action to turn it back into an inanimate dead tree. The tree then crumbles into ash.

sb.name: Alien Parasite
sb.damage_resistances: fire; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone
sb.senses: blindsight 300 ft. (blind beyond this radius unless perceived via its infection sense), passive Perception 19
sb.languages: understands Common and Deep Speech; telepathy 300 ft.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The parasite is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Infection Sense
traits.desc: The parasite knows the distance and direction to each creature infected by its ooze (see "Parasitic Infection" on page 4) within 5 miles of it. While a creature charmed by the parasite is within that radius, the parasite can see through its eyes and hear what it hears at all times, and the parasite can communicate with it telepathically using an extended version of its telepathy.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: When the parasite fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The parasite has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Planar Anchor
traits.desc: The parasite can't leave its lair, willingly or unwillingly, by any means short of a [[Tools/Spells/Wish|wish]] spell.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
traits.desc:
The parasite's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 19). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|detect thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Levitate|levitate]], [[Tools/Spells/Nondetection|nondetection]] (self only)
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Fear|fear]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|hold person]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Hold Monster|hold monster]]

actions.name: Assimilate
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: The parasite moves the target up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space and then forces the target to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target progresses to the next stage of the parasitic infection.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) psychic damage.

actions.name: Shatter Concentration (Recharge 4–6)
actions.desc: The parasite learns which creatures it can see are concentrating on a spell or other effect, and then forces one such creature to make a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage, and its concentration is broken.

bonus_actions.name: Parasitic Charm
bonus_actions.desc: The parasite chooses one creature it senses with its Infection Sense trait. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw, with a DC based on the stage of its parasitic infection: DC 13 (Stage 1), DC 15 (Stage 2), or DC 16 (Stage 3). On a failed save, the target is charmed for 24 hours. Although the charmed target isn't under the parasite's control, it takes the parasite's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can. The charm ends early if the parasite dies, does anything harmful to the target, or ends the effect as a bonus action.

legendary_actions.name: Ooze Strike
legendary_actions.desc: The parasite makes a pseudopod attack.

legendary_actions.name: Detonate Parasite (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The parasite chooses a non-neurophaged creature infected by its ooze within 5 miles of it, causing the ooze to explode. The infection is purged from the target, and it takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage for each stage of the parasitic infection it had. Each creature within 30 feet of the target must also make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw; the target automatically fails this save. A creature takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If a creature's saving throw fails by 5 or more, it progresses to the next stage of the parasitic infection.

legendary_actions.name: Psionic Blast (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Each creature of the parasite's choice within 120 feet of it must make a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw; targets more than 60 feet away from the parasite make this saving throw with advantage. On a failed save, a target takes 27 (5d10) psychic damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The druid is a 13th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Guidance|guidance]], [[Tools/Spells/Mending|mending]], [[Tools/Spells/Shillelagh|shillelagh]], [[Tools/Spells/Produce Flame|produce flame]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Burning Hands|burning hands]], [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|cure wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Healing Word|healing word]], [[Tools/Spells/Hellish Rebuke|hellish rebuke]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Flaming Sphere|flaming sphere]], [[Tools/Spells/Heat Metal|heat metal]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|hold person]], [[Tools/Spells/Scorching Ray|scorching ray]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Daylight|daylight]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Meld Into Stone|meld into stone]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Conjure Minor Elementals|conjure minor elementals]], [[Tools/Spells/Fire Shield|fire shield]], [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Fire|wall of fire]]
- **5th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Conjure Elemental|conjure elemental]], [[Tools/Spells/Mass Cure Wounds|mass cure wounds]]
- **6th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Move Earth|move earth]]
- **7th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Fire Storm|fire storm]]

actions.name: Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit (+9 to hit with [[Tools/Spells/Shillelagh|shillelagh]]), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands, or 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage with [[Tools/Spells/Shillelagh|shillelagh]].

actions.name: Change Shape (2/Day)
actions.desc: The archdruid magically polymorphs into a fire elemental. When the archdruid polymorphs, it gains 100 temporary hit points, and it can choose whether its equipment falls to the ground, melds into its new form, or is worn by the new form (if possible). While in this form, the archdruid's game statistics are replaced by the statistics of a fire elemental, except it retains its hit points, alignment, and personality. For the duration, its attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks. The archdruid reverts to its true form after 5 hours, if it loses all of its temporary hit points, or if it dies or falls unconscious. The archdruid can revert to its true form early using a bonus action on its turn.

sb.name: Aspect Elder
sb.languages: Primordium Common plus one other language Challenge 3 (700 XP)

traits.name: Dark Devotion
traits.desc: The elder has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Elder's Ward
traits.desc: The elder adds its Charisma modifier to its AC (included above).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elder makes two Bestial Strike attacks.

actions.name: Bestial Strike
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) force damage.

sb.name: Badberry Bush
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 12

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the bush remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal bush.

traits.name: Poisonous
traits.desc: The bush's berries appear to be edible, and magic identifies them as goodberries (as per the [[Tools/Spells/Goodberry|goodberry]] spell). A creature that hasn't observed the harmful effects of the berries must succeed on a DC 12 Intelligence (Nature) check to discern that they are badberries. When a creature eats a badberry, it takes 1 poison damage and must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 hour.

traits.name: Thorns
traits.desc: A creature that touches the bush or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (2d4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bush makes three seed attacks.

actions.name: Seed
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 15/30 ft., one target. Hit: 2 bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 2 (1d4) poison damage.

sb.name: Baron Ignean
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: exhaustion, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, unconscious

traits.name: Fire Absorption
traits.desc: Whenever Baron Ignean is subjected to fire damage, he takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to half the fire damage dealt.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.desc: Baron Ignean sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light in an additional 30 feet.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: When Baron Ignean fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Baron Ignean has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Baron Ignean's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Water Susceptibility
traits.desc: For every 5 feet Baron Ignean moves in 1 foot or more of water, he takes 2 (1d4) cold damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Baron Ignean makes three greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage, plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Prison (2/Day)
actions.desc: Baron Ignean conjures a wall of fire, which encloses a Medium or smaller creature he can see within 60 feet of him. The wall is a sphere or hemispherical dome with a diameter of 15 feet, and it is 3 feet thick. The wall is opaque, and it lasts for 1 minute or until Baron Ignean's concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). A creature that enters the wall for the first time on a turn or starts its turn in the wall takes 66 (12d10) fire damage. When a creature starts its turn enclosed by the wall, it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or flee in fear, taking the Dash action and using all of its movement to move in a random direction, passing through the wall and taking its damage in the process. Whenever a creature ends its turn enclosed by the wall, it takes 33 (6d10) fire damage.

actions.name: Flame Surge (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Baron Ignean releases a fiery explosion in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on himself. Each creature in the area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Baron Ignean automatically fails this saving throw.

sb.name: Bestiary of Imaginings
sb.damage_resistances: cold, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
sb.senses: blindsight 120 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 13
sb.languages: understands written Common but can't speak Challenge 5 (1,800 XP)

traits.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
traits.desc: The bestiary is incapacitated while in the area of an [[Tools/Spells/Antimagic Field|antimagic field]]. If targeted by [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], the bestiary must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

traits.name: Constructed Nature
traits.desc: The bestiary doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the bestiary remains motionless on a solid surface, it is indistinguishable from a normal tome.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The bestiary has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bestiary makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Manifest Monster (Recharge 4–6)
actions.desc: The bestiary magically conjures a quasi-real monster in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of it. The monster uses the statistics of an aberration, beast, monstrosity, or ooze of the bestiary's choice, provided it has a challenge rating of 3 or lower. The monster remains for 1 minute or until the bestiary's concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). The monster is immune to all attacks and effects, but whenever it would be subjected to damage, the bestiary must make a Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration on this effect, as if it had taken the amount of damage dealt to the monster. If the bestiary uses its Manifest Monster again, the first monster vanishes.

sb.name: Bookwurm, Huge
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.senses: blindsight 30 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 11
sb.languages: understands Common and two other languages, but can't speak

traits.name: Drilling Movement
traits.desc: The wurm can move through nonmagical objects that aren't being worn or carried using its burrowing speed, provided they aren't made of adamantine or mithral, and leaves a 10-foot-diameter hole in its wake.

traits.name: Improved Critical
traits.desc: The wurm's attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The wurm has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The wurm deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The wurm is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). The wurm has the following wizard spells prepared, which require no material components:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Acid Splash|acid splash]], [[Tools/Spells/Dancing Lights|dancing lights]], [[Tools/Spells/Fire Bolt|fire bolt]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|magic missile]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Enlarge/Reduce|enlarge/reduce]], [[Tools/Spells/Locate Object|locate object]], [[Tools/Spells/Shatter|shatter]]
- **3rd level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Counterspell|counterspell]], [[Tools/Spells/Nondetection|nondetection]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The wurm makes two attacks: one with its bite and one to constrict. It can cast one of its cantrips in place of one attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage (if the attack scored a critical hit, the damage dice are rolled three times, instead of twice). If the target is wearing nonmagical armor or wielding a nonmagical shield, the armor or shield (the wurm's choice) takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers, provided the targeted object isn't made of adamantine or mithral. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) force damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 16) if the wurm isn't already constricting a creature, and the target is restrained until this grapple ends.

sb.name: Bookwurm, Tiny
sb.senses: blindsight 10 ft., tremorsense 30 ft., passive Perception 10
sb.languages: understands written Common, but can't speak Challenge 1/4 (50 XP)

traits.name: Drilling Movement
traits.desc: The wurm can move through nonmagical objects made of a soft material (such as cloth, leather, paper, or rope) using its burrowing speed and leaves a 6-inch-diameter hole in its wake.

traits.name: Improved Critical
traits.desc: The wurm's attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) piercing damage. If the attack scored a critical hit, and the target is wearing padded, leather, studded leather, or hide armor, the armor takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 is destroyed.

sb.name: Bouncer
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
sb.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14

traits.name: Powerful Grip
traits.desc: The bouncer has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to maintain a grapple against a creature that is its size or smaller. It can only grapple one creature at a time.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bouncer makes four weapon attacks. It can attempt to grapple a creature or use its Throw in place of any of these attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Throw
actions.desc: The bouncer attempts to throw a creature it is grappling. The bouncer makes a Strength (Athletics) check contested by the target's Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check (the target chooses the ability to use). If the bouncer wins the contest, the target is thrown up to 30 feet away from it.

traits.name: Unbounded Divinity
traits.desc: Whenever the cleric makes an ability check or saving throw to escape or resist being grappled or restrained, it can use its Wisdom modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The cleric is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Guidance|guidance]], [[Tools/Spells/Mending|mending]], [[Tools/Spells/Sacred Flame|sacred flame]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|thaumaturgy]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Command|command]], [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|cure wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Grease|grease]], [[Tools/Spells/Inflict Wounds|inflict wounds]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Blindness/Deafness|blindness/deafness]], [[Tools/Spells/Branding Smite|branding smite]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|hold person]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Bestow Curse|bestow curse]], [[Tools/Spells/Magic Circle|magic circle]], [[Tools/Spells/Slow|slow]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Evard'S Black Tentacles|Evard's black tentacles]], [[Tools/Spells/Freedom Of Movement|freedom of movement]]
- **5th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Person|dominate person]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Monster|hold monster]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The cleric makes two flail attacks. It can only use this Multiattack if it makes both attacks against a creature that is grappled or restrained.

actions.name: Flail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

bonus_actions.name: Repentant Chains (5/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The cleric can only use this option immediately after it hits a creature with a weapon attack. When it does so, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or become grappled by divine chains until the start of the cleric's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Bind the Faithless (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.desc: The cleric conjures spectral chains around a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be restrained for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Dive Tactics
traits.desc: If the gull is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then makes an attack against it, it has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: The gull can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the gull can't bite another target.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: The gull makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the gull, and it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the gull's turns. If the gull takes 15 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the gull must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the gull. If the gull dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

sb.name: Citadel Highguard
sb.languages: Common plus one other language Challenge 2 (450 XP)

traits.name: Alert
traits.desc: The guard has a +5 bonus to initiative, and it can't be surprised. In addition, other creatures don't gain advantage on attack rolls against the guard as a result of being unseen by it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The guard makes two attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

sb.name: Conductor
sb.condition_immunities: exhaustion, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Fail-Safe
traits.desc: If damage reduces the conductor to 0 hit points, it drops to 1 hit point instead. This trait doesn't function if the damage is from a critical hit. When this trait is activated, the conductor gains a +5 bonus to its AC and all saving throws until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The conductor makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

sb.name: Coral Steward
sb.damage_immunities: poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
sb.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Aquatic Regeneration
traits.desc: While underwater, the steward regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the steward takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the steward's next turn. The steward dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Constructed Nature
traits.desc: The steward doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The steward is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Jagged Body
traits.desc: A creature that touches the steward or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet takes 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The steward has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The steward's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The steward makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Create Coral (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The steward conjures a mass of coral, which duplicates the effects of the [[Tools/Spells/Spike Growth|spike growth]] spell (if conjured on land) or the [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Thorns|wall of thorns]] spell (if conjured underwater), using a save DC of 14. This effect doesn't require the steward's concentration, but it immediately ends if the steward uses this action again, chooses to end it early (no action required), or dies.

sb.name: Corpse Flower
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, poisoned
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 12

traits.name: Alluring Scent
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the corpse flower must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by it. A creature charmed in this way must use all of its movement on its turn to move toward the corpse flower. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, that creature is immune to this corpse flower's Alluring Scent for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 11). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the corpse flower can't bite another target.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: The corpse flower makes one Bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the corpse flower, and it takes 5 (2d4) poison damage at the start of each of the corpse flower's turns. The corpse flower can have only one target swallowed at a time. If the corpse flower dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse flower's remains using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The druid is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Geminara makes two claw attacks. She can use Spellcasting in place of one attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. A humanoid reduced to 0 hit points by this necrotic damage dies, and a wailing shadow rises from its corpse and acts immediately after Geminara in the initiative count. The shadow is under Geminara's control.

actions.name: Illusory Appearance
actions.desc: Geminara covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like an elven girl, herself from her youth. The effect ends if Geminara takes a bonus action to end it or if she dies. The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, Geminara could appear to have no claws, but someone touching her hand might feel the claws. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that Geminara is disguised.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Geminara casts a spell that has a casting time of 1 action.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.desc: The sphinx is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the sphinx's intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The sphinx's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:

- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Tongues|tongues]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Banishment|banishment]], [[Tools/Spells/Freedom Of Movement|freedom of movement]]
- **5th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Flame Strike|flame strike]], [[Tools/Spells/Greater Restoration|greater restoration]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sphinx makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Spectral Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) force damage.

actions.name: Roar (3/Day)
actions.desc: The sphinx emits a magical roar. Each time it roars before finishing a long rest, the roar is louder and the effect is different, as detailed below. Each creature within 500 feet of the sphinx and able to hear the roar must make a saving throw.

actions.name: First Roar
actions.desc: Each creature that fails a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw is frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Second Roar
actions.desc: Each creature that fails a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw is deafened and frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature is paralyzed and can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Third Roar
actions.desc: Each creature makes a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 44 (8d10) thunder damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.

legendary_actions.name: Claw Attack
legendary_actions.desc: The sphinx makes one claw attack.

legendary_actions.name: Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The sphinx magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The sphinx casts a spell from its list of prepared spells, using a spell slot as normal.

sb.name: Ghost Train
sb.damage_resistances: acid, fire, lightning, psychic, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned, unconscious

traits.name: Detect Life
traits.desc: The train can magically sense the presence of living creatures up to 5 miles away that aren't undead or constructs. It knows the general direction they're in but not their exact locations.

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.desc: The train can see 1 mile into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The train doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The train can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: When the train fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The train has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Ghostly Ram
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target (as the train enters the target's space). Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) necrotic damage plus 14 (4d6) force damage. [[Tools/Spells/Etherealness|Etherealness]]. The train enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

actions.name: Soul Charge (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The train attempts to possess the soul of one creature in its space. The creature must make a DC 19 Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours. On a failed save, the creature's body falls into a catatonic state as its soul leaves it and enters the train. While the creature's soul inhabits the train, it can perceive from the train car where its soul is being stored using its own senses, but it can't move, speak, or take actions at all. If the creature's body is targeted by a [[Tools/Spells/Protection From Evil And Good|protection from evil and good]] spell, the creature can immediately repeat the saving throw, returning its soul to its body on a success; the creature's soul is automatically returned if its body is targeted by a [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Evil And Good|dispel evil and good]] spell. If the train is turned or targeted by a [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Evil And Good|dispel evil and good]] spell, one random soul within it is returned to its body. If the train dies, all souls within it are returned to their respective bodies. If the soul's body is dead when it attempts to return, the creature dies.

legendary_actions.name: Rush
legendary_actions.desc: The train moves up to half its speed. It can make one ghostly ram attack at any point during this movement.

legendary_actions.name: Soul Reap
legendary_actions.desc: The train chooses one creature whose soul it's possessing and regains hit points equal to twice the target's challenge rating (or the target's level, if it doesn't have a challenge rating).

legendary_actions.name: Steal Knowledge
legendary_actions.desc: The train magically asks a question of one creature whose soul it's possessing. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma saving throw or the requested information is revealed to the train. If the target doesn't know the requested information, the train instead learns one fact or secret about the target.

sb.name: Glass Ooze
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 8

traits.name: Frosted Form
traits.desc: Whenever the ooze takes cold damage, its form shifts to a durable solid. While in this form, its speed is halved, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it has resistance to all damage. At the end of its next turn, it reverts to its true form, or its Lighted Form if it's in bright light. It reverts in this way early if it takes fire or radiant damage.

traits.name: Lighted Form
traits.desc: Whenever the ooze is in bright light, its form shifts to a gooey adhesive, causing it to adhere to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the ooze is also grappled by it (escape DC 14); the grapple ends if the ooze is no longer in this form. It reverts to its true form if it enters an area of dim light or darkness.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ooze makes two pseudopod attacks.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage. If the ooze is in its Frosted Form, the target takes an extra 4 (1d8) cold damage. If it's in its Lighted Form, the target takes an extra 4 (1d8) fire damage and adheres to the ooze, as per that trait.

actions.name: Active Camouflage (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The ooze begins reflecting and redirecting light in such a way that creatures see through to the other side of it. The ooze becomes invisible until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the ooze wears or carries is invisible with it.

reactions.name: Concentrate Heat
reactions.desc: When the ooze takes fire or radiant damage while it is in dim light or darkness, it assumes its Lighted Form for 1 minute or until it takes cold damage.

sb.name: Gorilla Gargantua

traits.name: Ground and Pound
traits.desc: When attacking a prone creature, Gorilla Gargantua's attack rolls score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the Gorilla Gargantua fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Gorilla Gargantua has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Gorilla Gargantua's weapons attacks are magical.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.desc: Gorilla Gargantua's long jump is up to 60 feet and his high jump is up to 30 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Gorilla Gargantua can use his Frightful Presence. He then makes two fist attacks.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 44 (10d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage and the target is knocked prone if it is Large or smaller.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of Gorilla Gargantua's choice that is within 120 feet of him and aware of him must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Gorilla Gargantua's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Hurl
actions.desc: Gorilla Gargantua attempts to grapple one creature within 10 feet of him. If the grapple is successful, he can then throw the target up to 60 feet in a direction of his choice, knocking it prone. If the thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

legendary_actions.name: Leap
legendary_actions.desc: Gorilla Gargantua jumps up to 60 feet in any direction.

legendary_actions.name: Pounce (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Gorilla Gargantua moves up to 30 feet straight toward a creature. If he ends this move within 10 feet of the creature, he can use his Hurl on that creature or make a fist attack against it, knocking it prone on a hit.

legendary_actions.name: Quake (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Gorilla Gargantua repeatedly pounds his fists into the ground, sending shockwaves through the surrounding area. Each creature on the ground within 120 feet of Gorilla Gargantua must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone; creatures within 60 feet of him make this saving throw with disadvantage. A creature that fails its saving throw and is concentrating on a spell must also succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or lose concentration.

- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Command|command]], [[Tools/Spells/Faerie Fire|faerie fire]], [[Tools/Spells/Healing Word|healing word]], [[Tools/Spells/Tasha'S Hideous Laughter|Tasha's hideous laughter]]

actions.name: Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bardic Aria (4/Day)
actions.desc: The bard begins performing an aria, provided it can speak. This aria lasts for up to 1 minute; it ends early if the bard is incapacitated or chooses to end it (no action required). For the duration, the bard can cast some of its spells (marked with an asterisk in the Spellcasting trait) as a bonus action, though it can't cast the same spell twice on a turn. In addition, the bard and its allies within 30 feet of it that can hear the aria gain a +2 bonus to saving throws, and when such an ally makes an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, it can use its reaction to add 5 (1d10) to the roll. Once an ally uses this reaction, no creature can do so again until the start of the bard's next turn.

sb.name: Halcyon Spa Member
sb.languages: Common plus one other language Challenge 1/2 (100 XP)

traits.name: Disease Inoculation
traits.desc: The spa member is immune to disease.

traits.name: Ooze Telepathy
traits.desc: The spa member has advantage on Charisma (Deception and Persuasion) checks against any creature that is infected by the parasite's ooze, and it can communicate ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with them, out to a range of 100 feet. The communication's clarity is based on the stage of the target's infection: weak (Stage 1), moderate (Stage 2), strong (Stage 3), or perfect (neurophaged).

traits.name: Parasite-Controlled
traits.desc: While it is within 5 miles of the parasite, the spa member is charmed by the parasite and under its total control, as if by the [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Person|dominate person]] spell.

traits.name: Psionic Resilience
traits.desc: The spa member has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or possessed by a creature other than the parasite.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
traits.desc:
The spa member's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 11). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Message|message]]
- **3/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|detect thoughts]]

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

traits.name: Accursed Earworm
traits.desc: A creature that fails its saving throw against the harpy's Luring Song three times becomes cursed by the harpy. While cursed, the creature has disadvantage on any further saving throws it makes to end the effects of the Luring Song on itself, and it can't become immune to this harpy's song, even if it succeeds on the save.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The harpy has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The harpy makes two attacks: two with its claws and one with its greatclub or whip.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Whip
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Luring Song
actions.desc: The harpy sings a magical melody. Every humanoid and giant within 300 feet of the harpy that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the song ends. The harpy must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue singing. It can stop singing at any time. The song ends if the harpy is incapacitated. While charmed by the harpy, a target is incapacitated and ignores the songs of other harpies. If the charmed target is more than 5 feet away from the harpy, the target must move on its turn toward the harpy by the most direct route. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the harpy, the target can repeat the saving throw. A creature can also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it. A target that successfully saves is immune to this harpy's song for the next 24 hours.

sb.name: Lamp Golem
sb.damage_immunities: poison, psychic, radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
sb.senses: truesight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 12
sb.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Constructed Nature
traits.desc: The golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Cyclical Illumination
traits.desc: The golem has two modes for shedding light: daytime and nighttime. In daytime mode, it sheds warm bright light in a 60-foot radius and dim light for an additional 60 feet; this light is sunlight. In nighttime mode, it sheds cool bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The golem can switch between the modes as a bonus action.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Radiant Absorption
traits.desc: Whenever the golem is subjected to radiant damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the radiant damage dealt.

traits.name: Walking Censer (Corrupted Lamp Golem Only)
traits.desc: The golem emits Rot Fog in a 30-foot radius.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The golem makes two attacks with its claws.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Radiant Burst (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The golem momentarily supercharges the intensity of its light, forcing each creature within 60 feet of it to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 13 (3d8) radiant damage and is blinded until the end of the golem's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't blinded. If the golem is in daytime mode when it uses this ability, and any of this effect's area overlaps with an area of darkness created by a spell of 3rd level or lower, the spell that created the darkness is dispelled. If the golem is in nighttime mode when it uses this ability, a shapechanger subjected to the effect makes its saving throw with disadvantage; if it fails, it also instantly reverts to its original form.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The witch can breathe air and water. Enervating Aura. The witch's weapon attacks are magical. When the witch hits a target with any weapon, the target takes an extra 5 (1d10) necrotic damage (included in the attack). In addition, when a creature enters the area within 10 feet of the witch for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it takes 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.desc: The witch can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check.

traits.name: Rot Immunity
traits.desc: The witch is immune to the effects of Rot Fog (see "The Rot" on page 4).

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The witch's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Dancing Lights|dancing lights]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|minor illusion]], [[Tools/Spells/Vicious Mockery|vicious mockery]] (3d4) 3/day each: command, [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|detect thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Silence|silence]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Fear|fear]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|hold person]] (as a 3rd-level spell), [[Tools/Spells/Mirror Image|mirror image]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The witch makes two attacks: one with her dagger and one with her handaxe. She can cast a spell in place of one of her attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Illusory Appearance
actions.desc: The witch covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like another creature of her general size and humanoid shape. The illusion ends if the witch takes a bonus action to end it or if she dies. The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the witch could appear to have smooth skin, but someone touching her would feel her rough flesh. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the witch is disguised.

actions.name: Invisible Passage
actions.desc: The witch magically turns invisible until she attacks or casts a spell, or until her concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). While invisible, she leaves no physical evidence of her passage, so she can be tracked only by magic. Any equipment she wears or carries is invisible with her.

sb.name: Mandrake
sb.condition_immunities: petrified

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The mandrake has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage. If the target's form is altered (such as if it's a shapechanger or under the effects of a [[Tools/Spells/Polymorph|polymorph]] spell), it must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or immediately revert to its original form.

reactions.name: Shriek (1/Day)
reactions.desc: When the mandrake is touched by a creature or takes damage, it releases a shrill wail. This wail has no effect on constructs, undead, or mandrakes. All other creatures within 30 feet of the mandrake that can hear it must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 13 (3d8) thunder damage and is frightened for 1 minute. While frightened in this way, the target is incapacitated and its speed is halved. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target also falls unconscious until it is no longer frightened, until it takes damage, or until another creature uses an action to shake it awake. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't frightened.

sb.name: Merrow Cursebringer

actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it must succeed on a Strength contest against the merrow or be pulled up to 30 feet toward the merrow.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become diseased. The disease can be removed by any magic that cures disease and has no effect for 1 minute. After 1 minute, the diseased creature's skin becomes translucent and slimy, and the creature can't regain hit points unless it is underwater. When the creature is outside a body of water, it takes 3 (1d6) acid damage every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to the skin before 10 minutes have passed.

actions.name: Dominate (3/Day)
actions.desc: One beast, humanoid, or monstrosity the merrow can see within 30 feet of it must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw; the target has disadvantage on the saving throw if it is a merfolk or merrow. On a failed save, the target is magically charmed by the merrow until the merrow dies or until it is on a different plane of existence from the target. The charmed target is under the merrow's control and can't take reactions, and the merrow and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance. Whenever the charmed target takes damage, it can repeat the saving throw. On a success, this effect ends on it. No more than once every 24 hours, the target can also repeat the saving throw when it is at least 1,000 feet away from the merrow.

bonus_actions.name: Thrall Strike
bonus_actions.desc: The merrow commands a creature charmed by it to immediately make a weapon attack against a creature of the merrow's choice.

traits.name: Amphibious

traits.name: Ambusher

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: The merrow deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the merrow that isn't incapacitated and the merrow doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

traits.desc: The wurm can communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with any creature within 1,000 feet of it that is infected by the parasite's ooze.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.desc: The wurm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.desc: The wurm makes one bite attack and uses its psychic sting.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the wurm, and it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage plus 11 (2d10) psychic damage at the start of each of the wurm's turns. If the wurm takes 25 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the wurm must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the wurm. If the wurm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Psychic Sting
actions.desc: One creature the wurm can see within 60 feet of it must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence saving throw or take 33 (6d10) psychic damage.

reactions.name: Pustule Pop
reactions.desc: When the skélfilworg is hit by an attack from a creature within 5 feet of it, a pustule bursts open, spraying infernal mutagen at the attacker. The target must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 3 (1d6) acid damage and 3 (1d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.desc: The whale can't use its blindsight while deafened.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: The whale can hold its breath for 90 minutes.

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.desc: The whale has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The whale deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.desc: The whale makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: The whale makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller target. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed. A swallowed target is blinded, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the whale, and it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the whale's turns. If the whale takes 25 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the whale must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the whale. If the whale dies, a swallowed creature can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

traits.name: Devil's Sight

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

sb.name: Swarm of Flying Books
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 10

traits.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
traits.desc: The swarm is incapacitated while in the area of an [[Tools/Spells/Antimagic Field|antimagic field]]. If targeted by [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], the swarm must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

traits.name: Constructed Nature
traits.desc: The swarm doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the swarm remains motionless on a solid surface, it is indistinguishable from a normal set of books.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny book. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Bites
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 10 (4d4) piercing damage, or 5 (2d4) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

sb.name: T.D.M.A. Golem
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine weapons
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The golem's weapon attacks are magical. Standing Leap. The golem's long jump is up to 30 feet, and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The golem makes four weapon attacks, only two of which can be with its arm guns. It can use its Gatling Burst in place of two arm gun attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Arm Gun
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 80/240 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Gatling Burst (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The golem releases a rapid-fire burst from its arm guns. Each creature in a 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line extending from the golem must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus_actions.name: Overdrive (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The golem's Gatling Burst immediately recharges. Until the start of its next turn, the golem's speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to its AC, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it can make two additional slam or arm gun attacks as part of its Multiattack.

sb.name: The Guardian
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
sb.languages: understands Common but can't speak Challenge 13 (10,000 XP)

traits.name: Constructed Nature
traits.desc: The Guardian doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Rot Slayer
traits.desc: When The Guardian hits a target that is infected with Rot with any attack, the attack is considered magical, and the target takes an extra 6 (1d12) force damage.

traits.name: Shock Absorbent
traits.desc: Unless it is incapacitated, The Guardian has advantage on saving throws against effects that would push it, pull it, or knock it prone. In addition, it takes no falling damage if it falls, and it can land on its feet.

traits.name: Vigilant
traits.desc: The Guardian can't be surprised.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Guardian makes three attacks: two with its claws and one to constrict.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 16) if The Guardian isn't already constricting a creature, and the target is restrained until this grapple ends.

sb.name: Wailing Shadow
sb.damage_resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.desc: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the shadow has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

actions.name: Strength Drain
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. If a humanoid dies from this attack, an undead shadow rises from its corpse and acts immediately after this shadow in the initiative count.

actions.name: Wail (1/Day)
actions.desc: The shadow releases a sorrowful wail, provided that it isn't in sunlight. This wail has no effect on constructs and undead. All other creatures within 30 feet of the shadow that can hear it must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature becomes charmed for 1 minute. If the charmed creature takes damage, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a successful save, a creature takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, but isn't charmed.

sb.name: Warchief Guttormur
sb.damage_resistances: fire; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: charmed

traits.name: Corpse Aura
traits.desc: Warchief Guttormur's surroundings are littered with corpses and the extremities of his fleshy mass. For hostile creatures, the ground within 30 feet of Warchief Guttormur is difficult terrain, and opportunity attacks against them are made with advantage. In addition, creatures in the area gain no benefit from effects that would allow them to drop to 1 hit point instead when they are reduced to 0 hit points.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Warchief Guttormur's darkvision.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: When Warchief Guttormur fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Warchief Guttormur has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Unwavering
traits.desc: Warchief Guttormur can't be pushed, pulled, knocked prone, or banished against his will.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Warchief Guttormur makes three attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Hurl
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

bonus_actions.name: Subject Sense
bonus_actions.desc: Warchief Guttormur chooses one of his allies he is aware of within 120 feet of him. Until the start of his next turn, he can see through the target's eyes and hear what it hears. He can choose to end this effect early (no action required). While perceiving through the target's senses, he is blinded and deafened to his own surroundings.

legendary_actions.name: Absorb Ally
legendary_actions.desc: Warchief Guttormur telepathically commands one of his allies within 30 feet of him to move up to its speed toward him. If the creature ends its movement within 5 feet of Warchief Guttormur, he can absorb it, killing the creature and gaining temporary hit points equal to its current hit points.

legendary_actions.name: Battle Command
legendary_actions.desc: Warchief Guttormur telepathically commands one of his allies within 120 feet of him to make an attack against a target of his choice.

legendary_actions.name: Mutagenic Surge (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Warchief Guttormur causes the mutagenic essence within one of his allies to swell. The target gains the effects of the [[Tools/Spells/Haste|haste]] spell until the end of its next turn. (It isn't subjected to a wave of lethargy when this effect ends.)

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 2. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The cleric can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Liquid State
traits.desc: Whenever the cleric deals damage to a creature with a spell, it can also choose to push that creature up to 10 feet horizontally in a direction of its choice.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The cleric is an 8thlevel spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Guidance|guidance]], [[Tools/Spells/Ray Of Frost|ray of frost]] (2d8), [[Tools/Spells/Spare The Dying|spare the dying]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|thaumaturgy]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Create Or Destroy Water|create or destroy water]], [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|cure wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Fog Cloud|fog cloud]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Melf'S Acid Arrow|Melf's acid arrow]], [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|misty step]], [[Tools/Spells/Spiritual Weapon|spiritual weapon]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Gaseous Form|gaseous form]], [[Tools/Spells/Spirit Guardians|spirit guardians]], [[Tools/Spells/Water Breathing|water breathing]]
- **4th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Control Water|control water]], [[Tools/Spells/Ice Storm|ice storm]]

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Throw Holy Water (1/Day)
actions.desc: The cleric manifests a special vial of holy water and throws it at a fiend or undead it can see within 20 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 (3d10 + 8) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus_actions.name: Consume Holy Water (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
bonus_actions.desc: The cleric manifests a special vial of holy water and drinks it, regaining 17 (2d8 + 8) hit points.

reactions.name: Buoyant Bounce
reactions.desc: When a creature the cleric can see within 30 feet of itself is knocked prone, the cleric magically pushes the creature back to an upright position.

sb.name: Wildheart Unicorn
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, paralyzed, poisoned
sb.languages: all languages you know, telepathy 60 ft. Challenge—

traits.name: Charge
traits.desc: If the unicorn moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a horn attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 2d8 piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. The DC for this saving throw is equal to your druid spell save DC.

traits.name: Magic Resistance Aura
traits.desc: The unicorn and creatures of its choice within 10 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The unicorn's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Circle Spellcasting
traits.desc: The unicorn can cast any spell from your Circle Spells list, using your druid spell save DC and spell attack bonus.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The unicorn makes two attacks: one with its hooves and one with its horn.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: your druid spell attack bonus to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6 + your Wisdom modifier bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Horn
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: your druid spell attack bonus to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier piercing damage plus 1d8 radiant damage.

reactions.name: The unicorn can take one of the following reactions at the end of another creature's turn
Heal Self
reactions.desc: The unicorn magically regains hit points equal to 2d8 + your Wisdom modifier.

reactions.name: Horn
reactions.desc: The unicorn makes one attack with its horn. [[Tools/Spells/Shield Of Faith|Shield of Faith]]. The unicorn casts the [[Tools/Spells/Shield|shield]] of faith spell on another creature, which lasts until the end of the unicorn's next turn (no concentration required).
